title: the toolchain
description: Demonstrates the sovereign video toolchain end-to-end: the AEE cycle (SPEC → RTL → SIM → SYNTH → P&R → GDS → FAB → TEST) rendered on the RTX 3050, verified by the deterministic gate, receipted with SHA-256, and published to the truth surface. Zero cloud. Zero ML.
